name: Heřmánek
description: Heřmánek is the living proof that the thoughts are not our private secret. If his butt were a printer, he would leave us the complete psychological assessment nicely stored on a neat pile, together with all our great ideas just ready to be decomposed.
fullStory: The story around Hermanek can be told 23 years ago starting by the age of 8 years, and here is what can be told: Weeks of searching for a pony with Arabian look ended at a dark and dirty horse handler's place. All the village was expecting the incoming beauty. Yet, "something" else appeared. Excrement covering the fur, with several fresh injuries, a stinky creature was found and bought. "It" leapt on its own aboard the transporter ready for a new adventure and cared nothing for the emptied wallet, for the months of savings gone in exchange for what was supposed to be. Afraid to disappoint the excitement of the village, as soon as it arrived, "it" was hidden in the stables with goats, who couldn't stop laughing at him. At least it sounded like that. Called Kaspar or Mulisak, the "stinky pony" had to go through several treatments to heal his wounds and recover from his past mistreatment. As a wish of new beginning, a new name was given, the first which came out appeared to be perfectly fitting: Heřmánek (Chamomille). Time passed by, goats stopped laughing, and then… a miracle happened. No one knows, but one day in the spring there was standing a royal majesty pony king in his top beauty, arabian look, kind and soft character, sensitive behavior but unimaginable flash speed ready to race with complete universe! Heřmánek is able to read every thought of his rider and brings to life the most subtle intention, run faster than most of the big horses, jump higher than a fence, and escape through the window. Now in his later years, time has shortened his teeth so that he can no longer graze as he once did. Instead, he is tended with careful devotion: soaked hay, given every two hours, the rhythm of his days. And in return, he remains astonishing. On daily walks he still runs free, tossing his head with the spirit of a foal, reminding the world that his legs are yet the fastest of them all.

name: Banny
description: The story of this horse could be written as a book. In his early years, Banny didn't know what it meant to live a happy life.
fullStory: Despite his small size, Esteban ("Banny") was paraded into many jumping competitions under a talented girl rider. But his value existed only in the amount of obstacles he could clear. Even if his skills were great, soon he grew too small for the rider and was passed along to children who treated him less as a companion and more as a tool. The crack of the whip became the rhythm of his days. No gallop was fast enough, no effort sufficient to sate the endless demands. As a strong smart being, he searched many ways to reduce his suffering, gambling with his health and the brutality of the riders. After a tragic accident that left a dog dead under Banny's hooves, the last drops of human kindness vanished. In time, Banny broke – not in body, but in spirit. He would not step forward anymore, no matter the punishment. The strong mindset met the resignation. And yet, someone could see his suffering and, one day, came for him. Banny was allowed to go, to finally meet some love from human hands and, step by step, build trust again. With his extremely smart and strong personality, Banny came to Shaolin Temple Europe where he spent 13 years of his life. He gave unforgettable lessons to the weak and the small, but also to the arrogant and the strong: no one can hide away from the mirror in his eyes! Shortly before moving out from SLTE in the beginning of 2025, Banny was going through a dangerous period again – leak of care causes a radical loss of weight like never before. But after his arrival to the new temporary shelter, Banny's shape improved immediately. He is probably living the best period of life, running freely side by side with his small herd. Uplifting, joyful, confident, connected, aligned.
likes: to eat more or less everything
dislikes: zucchinis but will still eat it

name: Ramona
description: A very skinny elderly mare named 'Maike' (today Ramona) was bought by Shaolin Temple Europe in March 2023 to bring extra company for Banny and Heřmánek.
fullStory: Her body condition was long time controversial and finally improved in the spring and summer 2025. Even if not everything about Ramona can be healed anymore, yet, as time goes on, her specific beauty comes to light and the character gets finer. It is a pleasure to observe her facial expression, changing 3 times in a minute while behind those scary faces is a loyal, tender, sensitive and lovely pony lady. However Ramona is carefully checking people around and as she likes to challenge the presence of the ignorant, she will 'gently' bite the one who forgot himself. Ramona is simply a remarkably reliable horse in countless ways.

name: Loki
description: Before becoming the well-known guardian of the main door of the Shaolin Temple Europe and the mascot of Master Shi Heng Yi's live sessions, Loki was just an ordinary puppy.
fullStory: He and his brother were bought by Shaolin Temple Europe to be guard dogs, along with two White Swiss Shepherds. These four puppies were named Wotan, Odin, Loki and Fenris. It was a beautiful dream: 'Wolves' protecting the temple and its teachings. But they were not warriors yet; just young dogs with nothing else to do but battle each other. After a few struggles and injuries, Odin became the abbot's personal dog, while Loki, who had broken his leg, had to recover indoors. His broken front leg took a long time to heal. Screws were placed and then removed. Some had to stay in place forever. This gives him a distinctive way of walking to this day, sometimes hopping on the side to let his stretched leg take the next step. By the time they were seven, the four dogs were no longer a pack. Loki and Odin lived indoors, while Fenris and Wotan lived in the temple's atrium. Loki had an 'on-duty' character. Even though he wasn't assigned to it, he became the guardian of the main building's door at Shaolin Temple Europe. Anyone who visited the temple before March 2025 will remember him for barking at anyone who came onto the property. Once you had passed his check-in, you were part of the 'pack'. Loki is now still on duty. His front leg gets tired more quickly, and his back legs are losing their strength. However, with a little help, he still runs around with great enthusiasm. His condition requires a great deal of patience and effort from his caretaker. Every two to three hours, Loki has to be carried outside for his needs. Once a day, he goes for a walk in a wheelbarrow or on a trolley. Loki enjoys being moved around effortlessly with a big smile.

name: Fenris
description: Fenris is a black German Shepherd, the last letter of the word WOLF. No dog is more playful than Fenris.
fullStory: From a young age until now, he will ask you to throw either a big dead branch or a small piece of grass for him to bring back. This playful character has also made him known as a voracious killer. Any wasp or hornet flying near him had little chance of survival. Somehow, Fenris always knew how to catch them before they could sting. Despite his explosive nature when it comes to killing or chasing a stick or a dead leaf, Fenris is quite peaceful. He appreciates his peace. Loki learnt this the hard way when he once tried to test Fenris' patience to show him who was boss. Uninterested in power games but unwilling to submit, Fenris responded to Loki's provocation. Loki ended up with a broken front leg and had to be isolated from Fenris and Wotan. The two brothers were separated for years, and everyone at the Shaolin Temple Europe knew not to risk a new encounter. Last year, when Wotan needed extra care before his final moments, the three dogs were reunited; their advanced age had made them more tolerant of each other's presence. Yet, from time to time, the two black dogs still growl at each other as if they were veterans of long-standing enmity. With age, Fenris became surprisingly cuddly. He has also learnt not to run after ducks and chickens like he used to. He also started to lose some of his autonomy after a few strokes. He often falls suddenly because his balance is fragile. Nevertheless, he has his best time running with the three ponies on our daily walks.

name: Lora
description: In a small dirty pet shop, in the tiny cage was living for years a shy parrot lady, without much chance of getting a spaceful home.
fullStory: Flying was unknown to her wings and the greeting 'Ahoj!' was the only treat she got from the customers passing by, day by day. Dear Lora found her refuge for a short time in Shaolin Temple Europe, making groups of people laugh. Until she had to move again… Lora is a gentle, sensitive being able to enjoy the smallest little something, whatever it is.

name: Turtles
description: In Chinese traditions, turtles are the symbol of longevity due to their long aging.
fullStory: In Europe, they are often bought as small cute aquarium animals and when they get too big they are released into Nature causing terrible ecological unbalances. Our turtles are named after the everlasting pillar of the Shaolin traditions: Chan (Meditation), Wu (Martial arts) and Yi (Medicine). They represent the different branches of practices of the same tree of daily practice in Shaolin tradition.
dislikes: being disturbed during their sun bath

name: Small Water World
description: For several years, a small water world was hidden in the basement of Shaolin Temple Europe.
fullStory: A sacred room offering a moment of solitude and calmness surrounded by the diversity of swimming beings. Sometimes in the night late visitors in need of a place to sleep were secretly invited to rest in the vrooming of the filters, to clear out the worries running in their head. In their subtle manners, these little creatures gave their part by providing a peaceful atmosphere to the temple. Some of them survived the move of winter 2025 and are now waiting for the chance to balance the daily hectic Yang with a calm Yin Qi.
